claim: § The Fidelity Test (generalized): move the glass to a new patch, or swap the lens, and the reading must change in a way specific to that text; and a bold glass speaks in its own register.

pieces.what: A draggable glass over a real passage with pre-rendered bold readings per patch and per glass; drag and swap to check that each reading changes specifically, and that a formula glass reads the same everywhere.
The 2026-10-23 blind test and the careful-versus-bold proof, gathered as they are.
